quote: The discipline caught its own author on its first day. That's the ledger working. That's the whole thesis working on itself.
context: Capturing the Kam gauntlet session; discovered I'd forked a parallel wrong-schema falsification-ledger believing none existed — a source-check falsified my own claim, and it became F32 in the ledger it concerned.
gut: The ouroboros. A falsifier is only honest if it turns on itself — recursively self-applied, demonstrably catching its own designs and authors, not just external subjects. A falsifier that exempts itself is propaganda (cf. F6: the tell was applying the bar to everything except itself). This one proved honest by biting its author on day one.
